title: Resolution urging Albany to protect school bus workers in new contracts
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.1018/A.8440, which would amend the state Education Law to require job protections for school bus drivers, mechanics, dispatchers and attendants when contracts change hands. The measure aims to let the city Department of Education include these worker protections when it rebids its roughly $5.4 billion in school bus contracts, which currently run through 2027-28 and cover transportation for students including the 43% of yellow bus riders who have disabilities.
